source.name: Fybertech 4chan Archive (pages in 4chan's own markup)
source.short-desc: The subset of the Fybertech crawl saved as 4chan's own HTML rather than fybertech's rendered template.
source.capture: The 20 pages inside the fybertech crawl that are 4chan's own markup -- postContainer wrappers with data-utc timestamps -- rather than fybertech's rendered template, so `stage-native` moves them to out-native/ at prepare time and the `html` reader takes them from there. Mostly /co/ and /v/, 2012-2014. Both manifests read the same crawl, but no longer the same directory: `html-to-ndjson` parses the rendered generations into out-ndjson/ and `stage-native` copies these into out-native/, so the two readers cannot see each other's pages and the old mutual-skip logic is gone. Unlike the rest of the crawl these carry real UTC epochs, so their timestamps are second-accurate.
